tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Checks whether AI crawlers can reach and read a public website or web app: which AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more) robots.txt allows and the exact rule for each, how much text the homepage HTML carries for crawlers that do not run J

tools.name: list_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Lists the AI crawler user-agent tokens Atalaya checks, by vendor and purpose (training, search index, user-triggered fetch), so you can write a robots.txt that keeps AI search while opting out of training.
